title: Simultaneous Pretreatment of Aspirin and Omega-3 Fatty Acid Attenuates Nuclear Factor-kappaB Activation in a Murine Model with Ventilator-Induced Lung Injury.
authors: Kwack, Won-Gun; Lee, Yoon-Je; Eo, Eun-Young; Chung, Jin-Haeng; Lee, Jae-Ho; Cho, Young-Jae
one_liner_zh: 该文研究阿司匹林和omega-3脂肪酸预处理对呼吸机诱导肺损伤中NF-kB活化的影响，属于纯湿实验和临床前药理研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Ventilator-induced lung injury (VILI) is an important critical care complication. Nuclear factor-kappaB (NF-kappaB) activation, a critical signaling event in the inflammatory response, has been implicated in the tracking of the lung injury. The present study aimed to determine the effect of simultaneous pretreatment with enteral aspirin and omega-3 fatty acid on lung injury in a murine VILI model. We compared the lung inflammation after the sequential administration of lipopolysaccharides and mechanical ventilation between the pretreated simultaneous enteral aspirin and omega-3 fatty acid group and the non-pretreatment group, by quantifying NF-kappaB activation using an in vivo imaging system to detect bioluminescence signals. The pretreated group with enteral aspirin and omega-3 fatty acid exhibited a smaller elevation of bioluminescence signals than the non-pretreated group (p = 0.039). Compared to the non-pretreated group, the pretreatment group with simultaneous enteral aspirin and omega-3 fatty acid showed reduced expression of the pro-inflammatory cytokine, tumor necrosis factor-alpha, in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (p = 0.038). Histopathological lung injury scores were also lower in the pretreatment groups compared to the only injury group. Simultaneous pretreatment with enteral administration of aspirin and omega-3 fatty acid could be a prevention method for VILI in patients with impending mechanical ventilation therapy.
abstract_zh: 呼吸机相关性肺损伤（VILI）是重症监护中的重要并发症。核因子-κB（NF-kappaB）激活作为炎症反应中的关键信号事件，已被认为与肺损伤的追踪相关。本研究旨在确定在鼠VILI模型中，同时预先给予肠内阿司匹林和ω-3脂肪酸对肺损伤的影响。我们通过使用体内成像系统检测生物发光信号来量化NF-kappaB激活，比较了脂多糖序贯给药和机械通气后，预先同时给予肠内阿司匹林和ω-3脂肪酸组与未预处理组之间的肺部炎症情况。预先给予肠内阿司匹林和ω-3脂肪酸组表现出比未预处理组更小的生物发光信号升高（p = 0.039）。与未预处理组相比，同时预先给予肠内阿司匹林和ω-3脂肪酸组在支气管肺泡灌洗液中促炎细胞因子肿瘤坏死因子-α的表达降低（p = 0.038）。组织病理学肺损伤评分在预处理组中也低于仅损伤组。同时预先给予肠内阿司匹林和ω-3脂肪酸可能成为即将接受机械通气治疗患者预防VILI的一种方法。
